implementation.comparison: The old worker copy was hash-matched to the 4c305 source inventory and compared with the current source. Changes add bounded runStage timeout retirement, an owned-page retirement callback, and pass it to temporary-chat preparation and prompt attachment. Normal successful model selection, effort verification, submission and accounting are unchanged.
implementation.limitation: This does not establish compaction, multi-agent MCP lifecycle, live cancellation or current external readiness. Those checks are not inherited by this review.

conclusion: The four prior model routes, ten picker combinations, accepted-send accounting and documented catalog/DOM/viewport fixtures retain validity. The later timeout cleanup branch is bounded and has separate regression and real DEV recovery evidence; no fresh four-route run is justified by these changes.
